itemListElement.name: Notion Pricing: Plans and AI Credits

mainEntity.name: How much does Notion Plus cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Notion pricing page lists Plus at US$10 per member per month. It has a monthly and yearly payment selector, so check the selected billing mode and checkout total before buying.
Business includes Notion Agent, AI Meeting Notes and Enterprise Search beta. Custom Agents are priced separately at US$10 per 1,000 monthly Notion credits after the free trial.

mainEntity.name: Is the Notion Free plan enough for a team?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can work for a small trial, but collaborative blocks are limited for workspaces with two or more members. Free also has a 5 MB file upload limit and seven days of page history.

mainEntity.name: How long does Notion keep page history?

acceptedAnswer.text: The pricing page lists seven days on Free, 30 days on Plus, 90 days on Business and a custom period on Enterprise.

mainEntity.name: Do unused Notion credits roll over?

acceptedAnswer.text: Notion uses a monthly credit system for Custom Agents. Check the workspace usage dashboard and current billing terms for the applicable reset and rollover rules before setting an agent budget.
